articles.summary: Intrepid Potash, Inc. ("Intrepid", "the Company", "we", "us", or "our") (NYSE:IPI) today reported its results for the first quarter of 2026. First Quarter Highlights Management Commentary Supportive prices, resilient demand for potash and Trio ® , and continued improvement in Trio ® margins led to another quarter of strong financial results, highlighted by: Sales from continuing operations of $98.7 million; Net income from continuing operations of $6.9 million, or $0.52 per diluted share;
articles.title: Intrepid Announces First Quarter 2026 Results
